The qa-matrix-seeded FIXTURE_CUSTOMER already carries phone 555-0100 and a .local email (non-routable by RFC 6762, real delivery structurally impossible on non-prod) — see e2e/qa-matrix/fixtures/seed.ts's own comment. respond_to_review (A46) and B02 self-skip via a live precheck (tenant_integrations provider='google_business') rather than risk a public Google reply. emergency_dispatch (A23) self-skips via a live precheck on tenant_settings.owner_phone (must match the 555-01xx/02xx pattern) rather than risk a real SMS page to an unverified number.
